# sendgrid_single_send (Data Source)

Retrieves an existing SendGrid Marketing Campaigns Single Send by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "sendgrid_single_send" "spring_sale" {
  id = "27c21bbf-a12c-440b-b8bf-c526975328ca"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The Single Send's UUID.

### Read-Only

- `categories` (List of String) Categories associated with this Single Send.
- `email_config` (Attributes) The content of this Single Send. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--email_config))
- `name` (String) The Single Send's name.
- `send_at` (String) Not populated: SendGrid does not return this value in a directly comparable form. Always empty.
- `send_to` (Attributes) The recipients of this Single Send. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--send_to))
- `status` (String) The Single Send's status: `draft`, `scheduled`, or `triggered`.

<a id="nestedatt--email_config"></a>
### Nested Schema for `email_config`

Read-Only:

- `custom_unsubscribe_url` (String) The custom unsubscribe URL.
- `design_id` (String) The saved design ID, if any.
- `editor` (String) The editor used: `code` or `design`.
- `generate_plain_content` (Boolean) Whether plain_content is generated from html_content.
- `html_content` (String) The HTML content.
- `ip_pool` (String) The IP pool this Single Send sends from.
- `plain_content` (String) The plain-text content.
- `sender_id` (Number) The verified sender ID.
- `subject` (String) The subject line.
- `suppression_group_id` (Number) The unsubscribe group ID.


<a id="nestedatt--send_to"></a>
### Nested Schema for `send_to`

Read-Only:

- `all` (Boolean) Whether this Single Send goes to all contacts.
- `list_ids` (List of String) Recipient list IDs.
- `segment_ids` (List of String) Recipient segment IDs.
